Title: Notes
The Intruder: Eight-part series. Toonami's first Total Immersion Event. The first six parts ran daily from September 18–22, 2000, followed by the Absolution Afterburn Sweepstakes. Episodes seven and eight ran on November 6, 2000 and November 24, 2000 respectively.
Lockdown: Five-part series. Toonami's second Total Immersion Event. One episode aired each day.
Trapped in Hyperspace: Five-part series. Toonami's third Total Immersion Event. One episode aired each day.
Immortal Grand Prix: Five-part series. Toonami's fourth Total Immersion Event, and currently the only one not to feature TOM or SARA. The microseries was retooled into IGPX: Immortal Grand Prix, a 26-episode half-hour series. One episode aired each day.
Star Wars: Clone Wars: Ran for three seasons. Seasons one and two consisted of ten 3-4 minute parts, while season three consisted of five 11-12 minute parts.
Zurtrun: Seven episode microseries. Aired throughout Toonami's Attack on Titan marathon.
The Intruder II: Seven-part series. Toonami's fifth Total Immersion Event. One episode aired each week.
The Intruder III: Four-part series. Toonami's sixth Total Immersion Event. One episode aired each week.
Sand Whale and Me: Five-part series directed by Mamoru Oshii.
Countdown: Four-part series. Toonami's seventh Total Immersion Event. One episode aired each week. A complete rerun beginning at 11:30 PM on April 7, 2018, along with Scavengers.
